place.source_title: Farmer's Square Deal Cooperative Grain Elevator, Liberty & Division Streets

brief: Reinforced-concrete farmers' co-operative grain elevator of 1913 beside the tracks: a tall rectangular concrete working house with a raised headhouse, flanked by three round concrete storage bins (the lot's three 11 m parts), with a truck scale and office at the base. Record gap: 1 photo only.

facade.notes: the Farmers' Square Deal Co-operative elevator (Morris IL, 1913), HAER: a tall plain reinforced-concrete working house with a smaller raised headhouse on top, two small windows; weeds and scrub, a highway bridge behind -- the rail-side elevator every grain town had

why.note: grain moves by rail: farmers' co-ops built concrete elevators on leased railroad land beside the siding
